numeral.purpose: Stat-tile values and standalone measurements. Set in IBMPlexMono_700Bold — the one place the mono face appears at display size.

label.purpose: Section eyebrows and micro-labels, usually faded-copper-glow, uppercase, tracked.

mono.purpose: IBM Plex Mono, Medium/Bold. Every standalone measured numeral outside the Numeral role: SetRow weight/reps inputs, Rest Timer countdown, Home's WORKOUT number, numbered exercise badges, Progress trend delta.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: The only shadow token in the system. Applied only to the one focal Card per screen via the `elevated` prop.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Declared in tokens.ts for press-state transitions. Not yet wired to an explicit Animated call anywhere in the app; current press feedback is an instant opacity swap (0.85) plus haptic impact.

motion.name: base
motion.purpose: Declared, not yet consumed. Candidate duration for card/sheet entrances and tab transitions.

motion.name: slow
motion.purpose: Declared, not yet consumed. Candidate duration for progress-bar fills and milestone-stage transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action per screen. Fires a light haptic impact on press.
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height: 48px; border-radius: 14px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #b75a37; border-color: #d4713f; color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #c46540; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e6b08e; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.85; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Second action on a screen that already has a primary (e.g. Regenerate next to Start Workout).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #1c1c21; border: 1px solid #26262c; color: #f5f4f1; min-height: 48px; border-radius: 14px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #232329; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e6b08e; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { opacity: 0.85; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Tertiary row actions (Add set / Substitute / Skip).
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; color: #f5f4f1; min-height: 48px; border-radius: 14px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e6b08e; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { opacity: 0.85; }

components.name: Accent Pill
components.description: Tinted-surface label, never a solid fill — used for eyebrow-style status (e.g. 'Next session · Mixed').
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid #3b302d; background: #1d1614; color: #e6b08e; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.8px; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat at rest. Add box-shadow only for the one focal card per screen.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #141417; border: 1px solid #26262c; border-radius: 22px; padding: 16px; } .ds-card-body { color: #f5f4f1; font-size: 15px; margin: 0; } .ds-card--elevated { box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); }

components.name: Stat Tile
components.description: One numeral + one uppercase caption label. Used in 2-up fluid grids.
components.css: .ds-stat { flex-grow: 1; flex-basis: 47%; border: 1px solid #26262c; border-radius: 14px; background: #111114; padding: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-stat-value { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 26px; color: #f5f4f1; margin-bottom: 2px; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.6px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9a9aa3; }

components.name: Hero Glow
components.description: The system's one signature flourish: a soft copper radial glow, top-right corner of Home's hero Card only, never repeated elsewhere on a screen.
components.css: .ds-hero { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: #141417; border: 1px solid #26262c; border-radius: 22px; padding: 16px; } .ds-hero-glow { position: absolute; top: -60px; right: -60px; width: 220px; height: 220px; border-radius: 110px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 70% 30%, rgba(183,90,55,0.32), rgba(183,90,55,0) 70%); pointer-events: none; } .ds-hero-body { position: relative; color: #f5f4f1; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview:
Premium through restraint, not ornamentation — closer to a well-made watch than a fitness app. VYNKÆR's interface sits in near-total darkness with one warm light source: the copper accent, spent on exactly one focal element per screen (a primary button, a progress fill, a rest-timer readout) and never repeated as decoration. Everything else — panels, borders, secondary text — stays quiet enough that the one warm element is never in competition.

Confirmed visual rejections (from docs/PRODUCT.md and the current implementation): no badges, streaks, or gamified point systems; no neon gradients or cartoon "AI fitness" imagery; no generic SaaS dashboard clichés (gradient hero, hero-metric-plus-sparkline card template); no exclamation-point copy.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground with warm-tinted (never pure-grey) neutrals
One accent color, spent on one element per screen
Flat surfaces at rest; shadow appears only on the one card the user acts on next
Haptic feedback on every primary interaction — the "click" is felt, not just seen
Two typefaces, strict roles: system sans for every word, IBM Plex Mono for every standalone measured numeral
One hero glow (radial copper, top-right corner) — the signature flourish, never repeated elsewhere on a screen

rules.name: The Single Fill Rule
rules.body: Solid copper fill is reserved for the primary Button variant only. Every other accent-toned element — pills, eyebrows, the rest-timer label — uses a tinted surface with tinted text, never a solid fill.

rules.name: The Measured-Value Rule
rules.body: Every human-authored word renders in the system sans; every standalone measured numeral renders in IBM Plex Mono Bold. Never mixed within one sentence, never applied to a unit word next to a number. Extending it to a new element is a DESIGN.md-level decision.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one shadow value in the system. If a screen seems to need a second, heavier shadow, fix the layout, not the shadow scale.

dos: Do reserve solid copper fill for exactly one primary Button per screen (The Single Fill Rule).
Do treat completed/success states as their own color family — never reuse the brand accent to mean "done."
Do pair every primary interaction with a light haptic impact, and every "timer reaches zero" moment with a success-type haptic notification.
Do keep card-internal separation to border-subtle dividers rather than nesting a second card.
donts: Don't add shadow.card to a Card unless it is deliberately the one focal card on the screen (The One Shadow Rule).
Don't mix the mono numeral face into a sentence, or apply it to a unit word ("kg", "reps") next to a number.
Don't use badges, streak counters, confetti, or other gamified point systems anywhere in the product.
Don't apply the eyebrow/label uppercase-and-tracked treatment to body copy — it is reserved for section eyebrows and micro-labels only.
